messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] failure to install rstan either from terminal or website
parts:
You need a later version of R. The install
instructions are here:

https://code.google.com/p/stan/wiki/RStanGettingStarted

It says under the heading "Prerequisites" that

R version 2.15.1 or later is required;

You're not the first person to have this problem, but it's
hard to see how to make the instructions clearer.

Then you need to upgrade to the appropriate Rcpp.

- Bob
